title: Grange, Bohermeen, Co. Meath
description:
Lydon Farrell Property are delighted to bring the exceptional The Grange, Bohermeen to the open market. This 4 bedroom bungalow is a fabulous A-rated luxury home situated on a 0.76 acre site located just minutes from junction 9 of the M3. This special property has been meticulously designed, boosts many quality features and is in pristine walk in condition. This family home is very spacious throughout extending to over 220 sqm and internally is elegantly presented. 

On entering, you are welcomed by a wide and inviting bright entrance hallway, a large kitchen / living space and a sun room that opens out onto the patio area. The kitchen is a real feature of this home, it is perfectly presented and is bright, spacious and sufficiently sized to include a large island. The remainder of the ground floor includes a downstairs toilet, laundry room, storage closet, three double bedrooms, and a large ensuite bedroom with a walk in wardrobe. The attic was constructed to allow for future conversion if required. 

This stunning and luxurious residence is accessed through a feature gated driveway that leads through the professionally landscaped gardens that includes a patio area, mature flower beds and a block built garage that may have alternative uses.

The village of Bohermeen is conveniently located with both Navan and Kells within short driving distance of the subject property, while the popular McHughs Bar and Grocery is situated within short driving distance. Access to the M3 motorway is only minutes from house.

Viewings by appointment. 

Luxurious properties of this nature rarely comes to the market so viewings come highly recommended.
features: Spacious home with four large double rooms
Situated on a mature 0.76 acre landscaped site
Large master ensuite bedroom with walk in wardrobe
Located within close proximity to Navan and Kells
